sheet_layout: horizontal strip, frames left->right, frame_size each

tree_pine_snowy_a_sway.anchor: bottom-centre (same anchor as props/tree_pine_snowy_a.png; frame is 10px (1x) wider on each side so the canopy never clips)
tree_pine_snowy_a_sway.note: sway 16 f @ 8 fps, ~2.5 px canopy bend at 1x, base pinned below 30% height; randomise start frame + speed_scale (0.85-1.15)

tree_pine_snowy_a_shadow_sway.anchor: frame top-left = top-left of the matching tree_pine_snowy_a_sway frame; draw on the ground layer under all props
tree_pine_snowy_a_shadow_sway.note: cast shadow that moves with the canopy: frame i is the projection of sway frame i (light from the top-left, shear 0.62, squash 0.30, soft 2.2 px)
